title: What Is a Sound?
objective: Identify and match familiar environmental sounds.

narration.welcome: Welcome, Sound Detective! Put on your listening ears.
narration.teach: A sound is something we can hear. We hear sounds all around us.
narration.model: Listen. What do you hear?
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen first, then choose.
narration.close: Fantastic listening! You are becoming a Sound Detective.

title: Same or Different?
objective: Determine whether two sounds are the same or different.

narration.welcome: Today we are going to compare sounds.
narration.teach: If two sounds match, they are the same. If they do not match, they are different.
narration.model: Listen to these two sounds. Same or different?
narration.close: Great comparing! Your ears noticed the difference.

title: Loud and Soft
objective: Distinguish loud and soft sounds.

narration.welcome: Today we are listening for loud and soft sounds.
narration.teach: A loud sound is strong and easy to hear. A soft sound is gentle and quiet.
narration.model: Listen to this sound. Was it loud or soft?
narration.close: Excellent! You listened for volume.

title: Fast and Slow
objective: Distinguish fast and slow sound patterns.

narration.welcome: Today we are listening for speed.
narration.teach: A fast pattern happens quickly. A slow pattern takes more time.
narration.model: Listen to the pattern. Fast or slow?
narration.close: You caught the speed!

title: Sound Memory
objective: Remember and identify short sound sequences.

narration.welcome: Today we are going to use our sound memory.
narration.teach: Listen to the whole pattern. Keep it in your mind. Then choose what you heard.
narration.close: Amazing memory!

title: Listening Detective Assessment
objective: Demonstrate independent mastery of Module 1 listening skills.

narration.welcome: You are ready for the Listening Detective Challenge.
narration.instruction: Listen carefully. Take your time. Choose your answer when you are ready.
narration.close: Challenge complete! Your results are ready.

title: Meet Rhyme
objective: Recognise that rhyming words end with the same sound.

narration.welcome: Hello, Rhyme Detective! Today we listen for words that sound alike at the end.
narration.teach: A rhyme is when two words end with the same sound, like cat and hat.
narration.model: Listen. Cat... hat. Do you hear how they end the same way?
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen, then choose the word that rhymes.
narration.close: Great listening! You found your first rhymes.

title: Find the Rhyme
objective: Find the rhyme among a wider set of choices than before.

narration.welcome: Let's find more rhymes today!
narration.teach: Listen carefully to the ending sound, then find its rhyming partner.
narration.model: Listen. Can... man. They rhyme!
narration.transition: Now you try! Find the rhyme.
narration.close: Wonderful! You found the rhymes.

title: Odd One Out
objective: Identify the word that does not rhyme with the others.

narration.welcome: Today one word will be a trickster — it won't rhyme!
narration.teach: Listen to three words. Two of them rhyme. One does not belong.
narration.model: Listen. Cat... hat... dog. Which one does not rhyme?
narration.transition: Now you try! Find the word that does not rhyme.
narration.close: You caught the odd one out every time!

title: Finish My Rhyme
objective: Complete a rhyming pair with the matching word.

narration.welcome: Let's finish some rhymes together!
narration.teach: I'll say a word. You find the word that finishes the rhyme.
narration.model: Dog... and? Listen for the matching sound: log!
narration.transition: Now you try! Finish the rhyme.
narration.close: You finished every rhyme!

title: Make a Rhyme
objective: Select every word that rhymes with a given word, not just one.

narration.welcome: Today you get to make your own rhymes!
narration.teach: Think of a word that ends the same way, then choose it.
narration.model: Cap... what could rhyme with cap? Listen for map!
narration.transition: Now you try! Make a rhyme.
narration.close: You are a rhyming champion!

title: Rhyme Challenge
objective: Demonstrate independent mastery of Module 2 rhyming skills.

narration.welcome: You are ready for the Rhyme Challenge.
narration.instruction: Listen carefully. Take your time. Choose your answer when you are ready.
narration.close: Challenge complete! Your results are ready.

title: What Comes First?
objective: Notice that every word starts with a sound.

narration.welcome: Hello, Beginning Sound Detective! Every word starts with a sound — let's go find it.
narration.teach: Some words start the same way. Man and mop both start with the same first sound.
narration.model: Listen. Man... mop. Do you hear how they start the same way?
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen, then find the word that starts the same way.
narration.close: Great listening! You found the first sound every time.

title: Meet /m/
objective: Identify words that start with the /m/ sound.

narration.welcome: Today we meet a new sound: /m/.
narration.teach: /m/ says mmm, like at the start of map.
narration.model: Listen. Map... mat. Both start with /m/!
narration.transition: Now you try! Find the word that starts with /m/.
narration.close: You are an /m/ expert now!

title: Meet /s/
objective: Identify words that start with the /s/ sound.

narration.welcome: Today we meet a new sound: /s/.
narration.teach: /s/ says sss, like at the start of sun.
narration.model: Listen. Sun... sit. Both start with /s/!
narration.transition: Now you try! Find the word that starts with /s/.
narration.close: You are an /s/ expert now!

title: Meet /f/ and /n/
objective: Tell the /f/ sound and the /n/ sound apart.

narration.welcome: Today we meet two sounds: /f/ and /n/.
narration.teach: /f/ says fff, like fan. /n/ says nnn, like net. Listen closely — they sound different!
narration.model: Listen. Fan... fig. Both start with /f/! Net... nap. Both start with /n/!
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen carefully for /f/ or /n/.
narration.close: You told /f/ and /n/ apart every time!

title: Beginning Sound Mix
objective: Identify beginning sounds across /m/, /s/, /f/, and /n/ together.

narration.welcome: Let's mix up everything you've learned!
narration.teach: You know /m/, /s/, /f/, and /n/ now. Listen carefully — any of them could show up.
narration.model: Listen. Sun... sad. Both start with /s/, out of a bigger mix of choices!
narration.transition: Now you try! Any sound could show up — listen closely.
narration.close: You mixed and matched every beginning sound!

title: Beginning Sound Challenge
objective: Demonstrate independent mastery of Module 3 beginning-sound skills.

narration.welcome: You are ready for the Beginning Sound Challenge.
narration.instruction: Listen carefully. Take your time. Choose your answer when you are ready.
narration.close: Challenge complete! Your results are ready.

title: What Comes Last?
objective: Notice that every word ends with a sound.

narration.welcome: Hello, Ending Sound Detective! Words end with a sound too — let's go find it.
narration.teach: Some words end the same way. Cat and hat both end with the same sound.
narration.model: Listen. Cat... hat. Do you hear how they end the same way?
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen, then find the word that ends the same way.
narration.close: Great listening! You found the last sound every time.

title: Final /t/ and /p/
objective: Tell the /t/ sound and the /p/ sound apart at the end of a word.

narration.welcome: Today we listen for two ending sounds: /t/ and /p/.
narration.teach: /t/ says t, like at the end of cat. /p/ says p, like at the end of cap. Listen closely — they end differently!
narration.model: Listen. Cat ends in /t/. Cap ends in /p/. Which one matches?
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen carefully for /t/ or /p/ at the end.
narration.close: You told /t/ and /p/ apart every time!

title: Final /g/ and /n/
objective: Tell the /g/ sound and the /n/ sound apart at the end of a word.

narration.welcome: Today we listen for two more ending sounds: /g/ and /n/.
narration.teach: /g/ says g, like at the end of bag. /n/ says n, like at the end of pan. Listen closely — they end differently!
narration.model: Listen. Bag ends in /g/. Pan ends in /n/. Which one matches?
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen carefully for /g/ or /n/ at the end.
narration.close: You told /g/ and /n/ apart every time!

title: Same or Different Ending
objective: Decide whether two words end with the same sound.

narration.welcome: Let's check if endings match!
narration.teach: Listen to the ending of each word. Do they match or not?
narration.model: Listen. Map... top. Do they end the same way?
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen for matching endings.
narration.close: You checked every ending carefully!

title: Ending Sound Hunt
objective: Identify ending sounds across /t/, /p/, /g/, and /n/ together.

narration.welcome: Let's hunt for ending sounds!
narration.teach: You know /t/, /p/, /g/, and /n/ now. Listen carefully — any of them could show up at the end.
narration.model: Listen. Sun... hen. Both end in /n/, out of a bigger mix of choices!
narration.transition: Now you try! Any ending sound could show up — listen closely.
narration.close: You hunted down every ending sound!

title: Ending Sound Challenge
objective: Demonstrate independent mastery of Module 4 ending-sound skills.

narration.welcome: You are ready for the Ending Sound Challenge.
narration.instruction: Listen carefully. Take your time. Choose your answer when you are ready.
narration.close: Challenge complete! Your results are ready.

title: Meet Short A
objective: Identify words with the short /a/ sound.

narration.welcome: Hello, Vowel Explorer! Today we meet the short /a/ sound.
narration.teach: /a/ says a, like in the middle of cat.
narration.model: Listen. Cat... map. Both have /a/ in the middle!
narration.transition: Now you try! Find the word with the same middle sound.
narration.close: You are a short /a/ expert now!

title: Meet Short E
objective: Identify words with the short /e/ sound.

narration.welcome: Today we meet the short /e/ sound.
narration.teach: /e/ says e, like in the middle of hen.
narration.model: Listen. Hen... pen. Both have /e/ in the middle!
narration.transition: Now you try! Find the word with the same middle sound.
narration.close: You are a short /e/ expert now!

title: Meet Short I
objective: Identify words with the short /i/ sound.

narration.welcome: Today we meet the short /i/ sound.
narration.teach: /i/ says i, like in the middle of sit.
narration.model: Listen. Sit... fig. Both have /i/ in the middle!
narration.transition: Now you try! Find the word with the same middle sound.
narration.close: You are a short /i/ expert now!

title: Meet Short O
objective: Identify words with the short /o/ sound.

narration.welcome: Today we meet the short /o/ sound.
narration.teach: /o/ says o, like in the middle of dog.
narration.model: Listen. Dog... mop. Both have /o/ in the middle!
narration.transition: Now you try! Find the word with the same middle sound.
narration.close: You are a short /o/ expert now!

title: Meet Short U
objective: Identify words with the short /u/ sound.

narration.welcome: Today we meet the short /u/ sound.
narration.teach: /u/ says u, like in the middle of sun.
narration.model: Listen. Sun... cup. Both have /u/ in the middle!
narration.transition: Now you try! Find the word with the same middle sound.
narration.close: You are a short /u/ expert now!

title: Vowel Pairs
objective: Tell two different short vowel sounds apart.

narration.welcome: Let's compare two vowels at a time!
narration.teach: Some words sound very different in the middle. Listen closely.
narration.model: Listen. Cat has /a/. Cup has /u/. They sound different in the middle!
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen for which vowel matches.
narration.close: You told those vowels apart every time!

title: Vowel Sorting
objective: Sort words by their short vowel sound across all five vowels.

narration.welcome: Let's sort by vowel sound!
narration.teach: You know /a/, /e/, /i/, /o/, and /u/ now. Listen carefully to the middle of each word.
narration.model: Listen. Hen... pen. Both have /e/, out of a bigger mix of choices!
narration.transition: Now you try! Any vowel could show up — listen closely.
narration.close: You sorted every vowel sound!

title: Short Vowel Challenge
objective: Demonstrate independent mastery of Module 5 short-vowel skills.

narration.welcome: You are ready for the Short Vowel Challenge.
narration.instruction: Listen carefully. Take your time. Choose your answer when you are ready.
narration.close: Challenge complete! Your results are ready.

title: What Is Blending?
objective: Understand that separate sounds join together to make a word.

narration.welcome: Hello, Sound Blender! Sounds can join together to make a whole word.
narration.teach: When sounds blend, they join smoothly into one word — like m...a...t becoming mat.
narration.model: Listen. The sounds blend into: mat.
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen to the blended word, then choose the picture.
narration.close: Great blending! You heard the sounds come together.

title: Blend Two Sounds
objective: Blend a short sound chunk into part of a word.

narration.welcome: Let's blend short chunks of sound.
narration.teach: Two sounds can join to start a word, like m...a starting map.
narration.model: Listen. The sounds blend into: map.
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen to the blended word, then choose the picture.
narration.close: You blended those sounds together!

title: Blend Three Sounds
objective: Blend three sounds into a whole CVC word.

narration.welcome: Now let's blend a whole word!
narration.teach: Three sounds can join into a whole word, like m...a...t becoming mat.
narration.model: Listen. The sounds blend into: mat.
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen to the blended word, then choose the picture.
narration.close: You blended a whole word!

title: Continuous Blending
objective: Blend sounds smoothly, stretched slowly, into a word.

narration.welcome: Let's blend smoothly, like stretching a rubber band.
narration.teach: Stretch the sounds together slowly — mmmaaat — and they still make the same word.
narration.model: Listen slowly. The stretched sounds blend into: mat.
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen to the slow, stretched word, then choose the picture.
narration.close: You blended smoothly every time!

title: Blend With Pictures
objective: Blend sounds and identify the matching picture.

narration.welcome: Let's blend and match a picture!
narration.teach: Blend the sounds into a word, then find the picture that matches.
narration.model: Listen. The sounds blend into: dog. Which picture matches?
narration.transition: Now you try! Blend the word, then choose the picture.
narration.close: You matched every blended word!

title: Mixed CVC Blending
objective: Blend words across all five short vowels.

narration.welcome: Let's blend words with every vowel!
narration.teach: Any short vowel could show up now — listen carefully as the sounds blend.
narration.model: Listen. The sounds blend into: cup, out of a bigger mix of choices.
narration.transition: Now you try! Any word could show up — blend it and choose.
narration.close: You blended every kind of word!

title: Blending Challenge
objective: Demonstrate independent mastery of Module 6 blending skills.

narration.welcome: You are ready for the Blending Challenge.
narration.instruction: Listen carefully. Take your time. Choose your answer when you are ready.
narration.close: Challenge complete! Your results are ready.

title: What Is Segmenting?
objective: Understand that a word is made of separate sounds.

narration.welcome: Hello, Sound Segmenter! Every word is made of separate little sounds.
narration.teach: Cat has three sounds: c...a...t. We can count them!
narration.model: Listen. Cat: c...a...t. That's 3 sounds!
narration.transition: Now you try! Count the sounds in each word.
narration.close: Great segmenting! You broke every word into its sounds.

title: Count the Sounds
objective: Count the number of sounds in a word.

narration.welcome: Let's count sounds carefully.
narration.teach: Say the word slowly and count each sound on your fingers.
narration.model: Listen. Map: m...a...p. That's 3 sounds!
narration.transition: Now you try! Count the sounds in each word.
narration.close: You counted every sound correctly!

title: Stretch the Word
objective: Stretch a word out to hear each sound clearly.

narration.welcome: Let's stretch words like a rubber band.
narration.teach: Stretching a word out slowly makes each sound easier to hear and count.
narration.model: Listen, stretched slowly. Ssssuuunnn. That's 3 sounds!
narration.transition: Now you try! Stretch the word, then count the sounds.
narration.close: You stretched and counted every word!

title: Segment Short-A Words
objective: Count the sounds in words with the short /a/ vowel.

narration.welcome: Let's segment some /a/ words.
narration.teach: Short /a/ words like map and cat still have their sounds counted the same way.
narration.model: Listen. Cat: c...a...t. That's 3 sounds!
narration.transition: Now you try! Count the sounds in each /a/ word.
narration.close: You segmented every /a/ word!

title: Segment Mixed CVC Words
objective: Count the sounds in words across all five short vowels.

narration.welcome: Let's segment words with any vowel!
narration.teach: Any short vowel could show up now — count the sounds carefully.
narration.model: Listen. Bus: b...u...s. That's 3 sounds, out of a bigger mix of choices!
narration.transition: Now you try! Any word could show up — count its sounds.
narration.close: You segmented every kind of word!

title: Segmenting Challenge
objective: Demonstrate independent mastery of Module 7 segmenting skills.

narration.welcome: You are ready for the Segmenting Challenge.
narration.instruction: Listen carefully. Take your time. Choose your answer when you are ready.
narration.close: Challenge complete! Your results are ready.

title: Sound to Letter
objective: Choose the letter that matches a word's beginning sound.

narration.welcome: Hello, Letter Detective! Every sound has a letter that spells it.
narration.teach: Listen to a word, then find the letter it starts with.
narration.model: Listen. Bat starts with the letter b.
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen to the word, then choose its letter.
narration.close: Great matching! You found every letter.

title: Letter to Sound
objective: Choose the word that starts with a shown letter's sound.

narration.welcome: Now let's go the other way — letter to sound!
narration.teach: Look at the letter, then find a word that starts with its sound.
narration.model: Look. The letter g. Gum starts with that sound!
narration.transition: Now you try! Look at the letter, then choose its word.
narration.close: You matched every letter to its sound!

title: Build With Letters
objective: Represent a word's beginning sound with the matching letter tile.

narration.welcome: Let's build with letter tiles!
narration.teach: Every word starts with a tile — find the one that matches.
narration.model: Listen. Run starts with the letter r.
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen to the word, then choose its tile.
narration.close: You built every match with the right tile!

title: CVC Sound Mapping
objective: Map a letter to the words that carry its sound.

narration.welcome: Let's map letters to whole words!
narration.teach: Look at the letter, then find the word carrying that sound.
narration.model: Look. The letter d. Dog starts with that sound!
narration.transition: Now you try! Look at the letter, then choose its word.
narration.close: You mapped every letter to its word!

title: Letter Mix Review
objective: Match sounds to letters across all letters taught in this module.

narration.welcome: Let's mix up every letter you've learned!
narration.teach: You know c, b, h, r, l, d, g, and k now. Listen carefully — any of them could show up.
narration.model: Listen. Cat starts with the letter c, out of a bigger mix of choices!
narration.transition: Now you try! Any letter could show up — listen closely.
narration.close: You matched every letter in the mix!

title: Letter-Sound Challenge
objective: Demonstrate independent mastery of Module 8 letter-sound skills.

narration.welcome: You are ready for the Letter-Sound Challenge.
narration.instruction: Listen carefully. Take your time. Choose your answer when you are ready.
narration.close: Challenge complete! Your results are ready.

title: Build a Word
objective: Build a CVC word by placing its letter tiles in order.

narration.welcome: Hello, Word Builder! Let's put letters together to make a word.
narration.teach: Listen to the word, then tap each letter tile in order to build it.
narration.model: Listen. Mat. Tap m, then a, then t to build it!
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen, then build the word.
narration.close: Great building! You put every letter in the right place.

title: Change One Sound
objective: Change one letter in a known word to build a new word.

narration.welcome: Let's change one sound to make a brand new word!
narration.teach: Mat becomes sat when you change just the first letter.
narration.model: Listen. Sat. Tap s, then a, then t to build it!
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen, then build the new word.
narration.close: You changed sounds to build brand new words!

title: -at Family
objective: Build several words in the -at word family.

narration.welcome: Let's build the whole -at family!
narration.teach: Cat, hat, mat, sat, bat — they all end the same way.
narration.model: Listen. Cat. Tap c, then a, then t to build it!
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen, then build the -at word.
narration.close: You built the whole -at family!

title: -an and -ap Families
objective: Build words in the -an and -ap word families.

narration.welcome: Let's build two more families: -an and -ap!
narration.teach: Can, man, fan end in -an. Cap, map end in -ap.
narration.model: Listen. Can. Tap c, then a, then n to build it!
narration.transition: Now you try! Listen, then build the word.
narration.close: You built every -an and -ap word!

title: Mixed Word Building
objective: Build CVC words across all five short vowels.

narration.welcome: Let's build words with every vowel!
narration.teach: Any short vowel could show up now — listen carefully before you build.
narration.model: Listen. Dog. Tap d, then o, then g to build it, out of a bigger mix of words!
narration.transition: Now you try! Any word could show up — listen, then build.
narration.close: You built every kind of word!

title: Word Building Challenge
objective: Demonstrate independent mastery of Module 9 word-building skills.

narration.welcome: You are ready for the Word Building Challenge.
narration.instruction: Listen carefully. Take your time. Build your word when you are ready.
narration.close: Challenge complete! Your results are ready.

title: Short-A Reading
objective: Read words with the short /a/ sound.

narration.welcome: Hello, Reading Detective! Let's read some words.
narration.teach: Look at the written word, then find the matching picture.
narration.model: Read. Cat. Find the picture that matches!
narration.transition: Now you try! Read the word, then choose its picture.
narration.close: Great reading! You matched every word to its picture.

title: Short-E Reading
objective: Read words with the short /e/ sound.

narration.welcome: Let's read some /e/ words!
narration.teach: Look at the written word, then find the matching picture.
narration.model: Read. Hen. Find the picture that matches!
narration.transition: Now you try! Read the word, then choose its picture.
narration.close: You read every /e/ word!

title: Short-I Reading
objective: Read words with the short /i/ sound.

narration.welcome: Let's read some /i/ words!
narration.teach: Look at the written word, then find the matching picture.
narration.model: Read. Sit. Find the picture that matches!
narration.transition: Now you try! Read the word, then choose its picture.
narration.close: You read every /i/ word!

title: Short-O Reading
objective: Read words with the short /o/ sound.

narration.welcome: Let's read some /o/ words!
narration.teach: Look at the written word, then find the matching picture.
narration.model: Read. Dog. Find the picture that matches!
narration.transition: Now you try! Read the word, then choose its picture.
narration.close: You read every /o/ word!

title: Short-U Reading
objective: Read words with the short /u/ sound.

narration.welcome: Let's read some /u/ words!
narration.teach: Look at the written word, then find the matching picture.
narration.model: Read. Sun. Find the picture that matches!
narration.transition: Now you try! Read the word, then choose its picture.
narration.close: You read every /u/ word!

title: Mixed CVC Reading
objective: Read CVC words across all five short vowels.

narration.welcome: Let's read words with every vowel!
narration.teach: Any short vowel could show up now — read carefully.
narration.model: Read. Cat. Find the picture, out of a bigger mix of choices!
narration.transition: Now you try! Any word could show up — read, then choose.
narration.close: You read every kind of word!

title: CVC in Sentences
objective: Read a short decodable sentence and identify what it's about.

narration.welcome: Let's read whole sentences!
narration.teach: A sentence is a group of words that tells something. Read it, then find the matching picture.
narration.model: Read. The cat sat. Find the picture that matches!
narration.transition: Now you try! Read the sentence, then choose its picture.
narration.close: You read every sentence!

title: Reading Challenge
objective: Demonstrate independent mastery of Module 10 reading skills.

narration.welcome: You are ready for the Reading Challenge.
narration.instruction: Read carefully. Take your time. Choose your answer when you are ready.
narration.close: Challenge complete! Your results are ready.
